t: Features 3 interchangeable tool ends. Consists of a 250mm webbing loop, heavy duty steel snap hook and a dual-channel barrel lock to ensure a safe and secure tool attachment. Features a stainless steel locking carabiner and a strong one-piece, internal shock cord with tight weave nylon webbing to prevent over-extension and snagging. Multiple connections methods, including belt loop and carabiner, allow the flexibility to find the most suitable anchor point. Tool ends are compatible with the Roughneck Wrist Lanyard.
